assign.request: UX rethink pass on /imagine/vary/ - five sentences, try an alternative layout and measure it, make it more visual, check persistence, resolve and land
steps: read brief + realm files + review card
check colstyles color x layout permutation

log.msg: Alternative built and measured: swapped previews() for walls() (index-of-indexes, all 15 real variation pages shown grouped under 4 headings instead of 4 abstract lab cards). Column body height at 3440 grew 852px->1373px (+61%, now needs scrolling past the fold on a mega monitor where it used to fit whole); at 1280 860px->1111px (+29%). Width used unchanged (large word caps it either way). Gain: saves one click to reach a named variation, and replaces 4 abstract nouns with ~15 concrete labels. Reverted: the height cost is real and it does nothing about the actual defect (icon-only cards at every level, now x4 more of them) - three prior reviewers own biggest win was a real still, not more text cards. Vary landing is a menu-of-choices wall of children, so per known findings the 3-column card is already disproven for this shape - did not re-build it. The paging-vocabulary surface change is already what core does here (clicking a card opens a sliding column beside the current one, not a takeover) so there is no cheap win there without a core change (out of fence).

Visual fix landed: overrode preview(nav) on all four lab index pages (scroll, tone, place, colstyles) to show a real screenshot of that labs own demo instead of the default icon+description card. Shots at public/imagine/vary/shots/{scroll,tone,place,colstyles}.jpg, captured from real leaf pages (scroll/padded, tone/flip, place/carousel, colstyles/glass). Measured: page height unchanged (860px->860px at 1280, 852px->852px at 3440), width used unchanged (46.0% at 3440, the columns-row reserve is site-wide and not this pages fix), zero console errors on the landing page or any of the four lab pages at 1280/3440. Invariants: no content at x:0 (column starts at 210px/432px), no prose line past 40em, no framed box touching the column edge - pass, unchanged from before.

Owner asked tonight for color variations permutated with layout variations; checked colstyles for real - before this change the permutation was named but not built: four colour looks (finder/cards/ink/glass) all shown on ONE fixed width, and the layout axis (width word) only existed, uncrossed, in hooks widths() demo. Thickened it: added a Permutation section to colstyles/page.js crossing all four looks against two real column widths (18em narrow, 34em wide), eight small demo.app() boxes in a 2-row grid using the existing tree() generator, zero new CSS. Verified: zero console errors, no real horizontal overflow (document.documentElement.scrollWidth === viewport width at 1280), every look still readable at both widths. Named but left undone (out of budget): the reverse crossing - one look through several STRUCTURAL layouts (place/s add/swap/carousel) rather than just width.

Persistence check: grep for store()/localStorage in public/imagine/vary/ returned nothing - the realm persists nothing. UI-test: clicked the Tone card on /imagine/vary/, watched .page--tone .page-column-body go missing->present and location.pathname become /imagine/vary/tone/ - the primary gesture (open a lab as a new column) proved. Console: zero errors at 1280/3440 on the landing page and all four lab pages; one transient /imagine/team/page.js syntax error seen once on a concurrent sibling reviewers mid-edit, gone on re-check, not from this realm. Doc pass: colstyles/readme.md + doc/decisions.md updated to record the permutation section.

assign.outcome: **Four icon cards became four real stills, and colstyles' color-x-layout permutation went from named to built.** The /imagine/vary/ landing page's four lab cards (Scroll, Tone, Place, Colstyles) now show an actual screenshot of what each lab looks like instead of a generic material icon and a clipped description - zero height cost, zero console errors, at [/imagine/vary/](/imagine/vary/). Tried and reverted an index-of-indexes alternative (`walls()`, showing all 15 real variation pages up front) - it grew the column's own height 61% at 3440 for a one-click saving, without fixing the actual defect, so the tile wall stayed. Colstyles' color x layout permutation - the owner's own ask tonight - was checked for real and found thin (four looks, one fixed width); added a section crossing all four looks against two real column widths at [/imagine/vary/colstyles/](/imagine/vary/colstyles/), documented in `doc/decisions.md`. Persistence: none. UI-tested the primary gesture (click a lab card, open its own column) - proved. Full report in the reviewer's final message.
